speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing inappropriate behavior, changes in eating habits, and weight gain. To understand the root cause, do you have a history of thyroid issues or diabetes?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male. The patient has demonstrated inappropriate behavior, including making unfitting comments and attempts to kiss strangers, over the past 6 months. He shows disinterest in family interactions and has developed a particular craving for chocolate pudding and potato chips, resulting in a 10 kg weight gain. The patient also presents as unkempt.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very specific set of symptoms. You are a 55-year-old male who has gained 10 kg in 6 months, crave sweets and starches, and have developed socially inappropriate behaviors like making unfitting comments and attempting to kiss strangers? Have you noticed any changes in your vision or increased thirst and urination?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inappropriate behavior. I also have Disinterest in family interactions, Craving for specific foods, Significant weight gain, Apathy, Blunted affect.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome. The combination of central weight gain, craving sweets/starches, progressive behavioral changes (disinhibition, apathy, blunted affect), and unkempt appearance is highly characteristic of hypercortisolism.

REQUEST TEST: Serum_Cortisol_24h_Urine, Plasma_Aldosterone, ACTH_level, Dexamethasone_Suppression_Test.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CTA.
